messages:
pagerduty-bot: PAGER: infer-usw-3 kubelet NotReady on 2 nodes (node-12, node-14). Severity: Sev2. Symptoms: increased 5xx and Pod eviction. Link: https://pager.example/incident/2859992100
maya: Ack. i'm taking this. pinging infra to confirm scale.
jon: Oncall here — collecting quick context. Which pools impacted?
maya: hosted-inference-usw and dedicated-infer-usw-pool. 5xx rate up ~18% over baseline, p50 latency x3. No reported data loss yet.
infra-bot: Autoscaler event at +14:02 UTC — started 2 nodes in infer-pool-usw. Node-12 kubelet last heartbeat 14:00:44, node-14 heartbeat 14:03:05 then NotReady.
sam: can we get kubelet logs?
jon: grabbing kubelet logs -> snippet:
```
Nov 07 14:03:04 node-14 kubelet[1234]: E1107 14:03:04 kubelet.go:245] kubelet: container runtime status not responding
Nov 07 14:03:04 node-14 kernel: nvidia 0000:01:00.0: GPU reset request
Nov 07 14:03:06 node-14 kubelet[1234]: E1107 14:03:06 eviction_manager.go:399] eviction signal: allocatableMemory
```
maya: looks like GPU driver resets causing kubelet disconnects. plan: cordon/drain node-14, restart kubelet, and route traffic off problem nodes. also scale up pool by 2 for safety.
carol: i'll prep a drain command. small note: we should use --grace-period=30 for the long-running inference pods with checkpointing.
jon: executing now:
```
kubectl cordon node-14
kubectl drain node-14 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=30
ssh node-14 'sudo systemctl restart kubelet'
```
infra-bot: Scaling infer-pool-usw +2 replicas to absorb in-flight requests.
sam: switched routing -> extra capacity target to infer-useast for non-high-priority customers. fallback model rwd-small enabled for bursty calls :white_check_mark:
maya: customer impact: CS told me 6 customers saw transient latency spikes and ~50 failed requests each. no PII exposure. raising post-incident note.
carol: node-14 kubelet restarted, logs show driver rebind in progress. monitoring pod recreation.
jon: node-12 still flapping intermittently. i've cordoned node-12 as well and flagged for node-replacement if it flaps again.
infra-bot: health checks green on scaled nodes. traffic rate back to 95% baseline.
maya: handing off to carol for watch. i'll update incident with actions and start a follow-up ticket for GPU driver upgrade on infer-usw fleet.
carol: taking handoff — will monitor next 30m and escalate to eng-sre if we see >2 recurrences. :eyes:
pagerduty-bot: Incident status -> monitoring. responders: maya, jon, carol. closing pager for now; reopen if recurring.
